messages.text: I can do 150 P. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 88 P for this one.
Thanks for the offer! I can come down to 136 P for the Palacio de Cristal.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 106 P, please?
Thanks for moving. I can come down to 130 P, which I think is fair for the Palacio de Cristal.
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway at 114 P.
Thank you, we are getting close: I can do 126 P to settle this.
Thank you, we are getting close. 119 P works for me.
We're close indeed - I can do 123 P and sign right away.
Thank you for your offer. I can move to 120 P.
We're almost there. I can do 122 P to close this now.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 121 P, please?
